title.zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
title.en: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna

current_state.zh: Anthropic已发布Claude Haiku 5.5，独立评测显示其综合智能指数43分，超过GPT-6 Luna的38分，但最高推理档token消耗与成本更高；市场反应方面，智谱和MiniMax股价因竞争压力大跌。
current_state.en: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5; independent evaluation shows a composite intelligence index score of 43, ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38, but with higher token usage and cost at max effort; in market reaction, Zhipu and MiniMax shares dropped significantly on competitive pressure.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
updates.title_en: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5，这是一款面向智能体的轻量级模型，API价格降低90%，并声称在计算机使用、专业工作和编程评估中基准测试成绩超过GPT-6 Luna。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5, a lightweight agent-focused model that cuts API prices by 90% and claims benchmark wins over GPT-6 Luna in computer-use, professional-work, and coding evaluations.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5，这是一款面向智能体的轻量级模型，API价格降低90%，并声称在计算机使用、专业工作和编程评估中基准测试成绩超过GPT-6 Luna。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5, a lightweight agent-focused model that cuts API prices by 90% and claims benchmark wins over GPT-6 Luna in computer-use, professional-work, and coding evaluations.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5, a lightweight agent-focused model that cuts API prices by 90% and claims benchmark wins over GPT-6 Luna in computer-use, professional-work, and coding evaluations.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5, a lightweight agent-focused model that cuts API prices by 90% and claims benchmark wins over GPT-6 Luna in computer-use, professional-work, and coding evaluations.

updates.title_zh: Haiku 5.5独立评测43分：遥遥领先GPT-6 Luna，但最高档Token消耗超3倍
updates.title_en: Haiku 5.5独立评测43分：遥遥领先GPT-6 Luna，但最高档Token消耗超3倍
updates.what_changed_zh: 第三方评测机构Artificial Analysis公布Claude Haiku 5.5独立评测结果：综合智能指数43分，超GPT-6 Luna的38分，但最高推理档每任务输出约16.2万tokens，为Luna的3.2倍，预估单任务成本约0.21美元 vs Luna的0.07美元；high档得分38分且token用量接近Luna。
updates.what_changed_en: Artificial Analysis released independent evaluation results for Claude Haiku 5.5: composite intelligence index score of 43, ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38, but at maximum reasoning effort it outputs about 162k tokens per task (3.2x Luna) with estimated per-task cost around $0.21 vs Luna's $0.07; at high effort it scores 38 with token usage close to Luna.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic已发布Claude Haiku 5.5。第三方评测显示其综合智能指数43分，超过GPT-6 Luna的38分，但最高推理档token消耗与成本显著更高；high档性能接近Luna且成本更低。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5. Independent evaluation shows a composite intelligence index score of 43, ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38, but at maximum reasoning effort token usage and cost are significantly higher; at high effort it performs near Luna with lower cost.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Artificial Analysis's independent evaluation scores Claude Haiku 5.5 at 43 on its composite intelligence index — ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38 and near Kimi K3's 44 — but finds it burns roughly 3.2x the tokens of Luna at maximum reasoning effort, pushing estimated per-task cost to about $0.21 versus $0.07, while its high-effort tier nearly matches Luna at far lower token usage.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Artificial Analysis's independent evaluation scores Claude Haiku 5.5 at 43 on its composite intelligence index — ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38 and near Kimi K3's 44 — but finds it burns roughly 3.2x the tokens of Luna at maximum reasoning effort, pushing estimated per-task cost to about $0.21 versus $0.07, while its high-effort tier nearly matches Luna at far lower token usage.

updates.title_zh: Claude杀入国产低价模型腹地：智谱、MiniMax盘中大跌
updates.title_en: Claude杀入国产低价模型腹地：智谱、MiniMax盘中大跌
updates.what_changed_zh: 受Claude Haiku 5.5发布带来的定价与性能竞争压力影响，港股大模型公司智谱和MiniMax股价盘中分别下跌超过6%和9%。
updates.what_changed_en: Amid competitive pricing and performance pressure from the Claude Haiku 5.5 launch, Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares fell more than 6% and 9% intraday.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic已发布Claude Haiku 5.5，独立评测显示其综合智能指数43分，超过GPT-6 Luna的38分，但最高推理档token消耗与成本更高；市场反应方面，智谱和MiniMax股价因竞争压力大跌。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5; independent evaluation shows a composite intelligence index score of 43, ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38, but with higher token usage and cost at max effort; in market reaction, Zhipu and MiniMax shares dropped significantly on competitive pressure.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 launch undercuts Chinese low-cost models on API pricing and tops comparable Artificial Analysis/Terminal-Bench scores, sending Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares down more than 6% and 9% respectively.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 launch undercuts Chinese low-cost models on API pricing and tops comparable Artificial Analysis/Terminal-Bench scores, sending Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares down more than 6% and 9% respectively.
